description.narrative: Samarbetet mellan UMT och SALAR syftar till att stödja decentralisering och kommunreform i Turkiet genom att utveckla och använda nya tekniker för deltagande lokal demokrati. Såväl turkiska som svenska parter deltar.

UMT and SALAR cooperation aims at further supporting the process of decentralisation and municipal reform in Turkey through the development and implementation of new techniques in participatory local democracy. The modality will engage both Turkish and Swedish partners.

sector.narrative: Decentralisation and support to subnational government

description.narrative:
General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2016Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The final report presents achieved results in relation to the intended outcomes and outputs of the project “Turkish-Swedish Partnership for Local Governance” which has facilitated cooperation between Union of Municipalities of Turkey (UMT) and the Swedish Association of Local Authorities and Regions (SALAR). SKL International has been responsible for the implementation of the project as well as for writing the final report.
Although there has been an aim to build sustainable results throughout the project the current political and social context in Turkey are unfortunately likely to hamper these.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
